Fresh run tick 1 texts [name, 'Best: 0', Start, Settings, Quit], saved false; 1:enter -> tick 2 screen play, wave 1, score 0, coins 0, gate_health 10.

es and fr runs: title (Mejor/Empezar/Continuar/Ajustes/Salir; Meilleur/Commencer/Continuer/Reglages/Quitter), settings, play HUD (Oleada 1 de 8 / Vague 1 sur 8), shop, paused, won, lost all fully translated; only the game name stays English (Spanish end line reads 'Enter: titulo', the key name).
Run 1 with --settings k1 set volume 7, fr, hard; run 2 with same folder started with volume 7, language fr, difficulty hard (gate 7). A fresh folder started en / 8 / normal.
Hold up from tick 2: guard_y 6 -> 9 at tick 32 -> 12 at tick 62, stays 12; hold down: 2.0 at 200, 0 at 300 and 400 (clamped).
Held shoot from tick 25: new bolts at x=2 on ticks 25, 49, 73, 97, 121 (24 ticks); bolt advances 0.2333/tick (14/s); a bolt at 19.27 was gone 10 ticks later (past x=20).
Seed 1, no shooting: walkers appear at x=20 on ticks 2, 92, 182, 272, 362 (90 ticks), lanes 2,4,8,6,6, health 2, x drops 0.025/tick (1.5/s); no 6th walker.

Guard at y=6 holding shoot: bolts passed the y=4 and y=2 walkers untouched (health 2); a walker hit once showed health 1; second hit removed it, score 0->10, coins 0->1; bolt at y=3.7 hit the y=4 walker (within 0.6).
Walker at x=0 at tick 802 is gone at 803, gate 10->9, score/coins unchanged; hard run with gate 4 in wave 2 ended screen lost, texts ['You lost','Score: 20','Best: 20','Enter: title'], gate 0.
Difficulty easy kept, then Start: gate_health 14; hard: gate_health 7.

After the 5th walker passed (tick 1163) screen shop, texts [Shop, 'Coins: 0', 'Next: wave 2 of 8', Quick hands + 'Price: 5 coins', Heavy bolts + 'Price: 12 coins', Mason + 'Price: 4 coins', Next wave]; state identical at 1164..1300 with up/escape pressed.

start_coins=17, Quick hands once (coins 17->12): held shoot spawned bolts at 1214, 1232, 1250 (18 ticks). start_coins=40, bought twice (40->35->25): bolts every 12 ticks (1194, 1206, 1218); third Enter left coins 25, quick 2.
Heavy bought (12 coins): a full-health walker at y=4 removed by one bolt at tick 1288 (score 0->10, coins 0->1); second purchase left coins 13 and heavy 1.
Gate 5/10, coins 13: Mason -> gate 8 coins 9; Mason -> gate 10 (capped) coins 5; Mason at full -> coins 5 gate 10. With 0 coins and gate 5, Enter on Mason left coins 0 gate 5.
Next wave entered at tick 12, first walker at x=20 at tick 72 (60 later); 7 walkers by tick 612 and no more at 702; HUD 'Wave 2 of 8' (es 'Oleada 2 de 8', fr 'Vague 2 sur 8').
--set start_wave=3: 6 walkers at ticks 2..362, then 4 runners at 434, 506, 578, 650 (72 ticks), health 1, x drops 0.05/tick (3/s); a runner shot gave score 0->15, coins 0->1.
--set start_wave=4: 8 walkers then a brute at tick 578 (last), health 6, 1/60 per tick; reaching the gate it took 12->9; shot down it gave score 10->50, coins 1->4.
modules/work/waves.json holds per-wave walkers/runners/brutes/every; lib.rs only reads it; README 'How to change a wave' says to edit that file.

Played waves 1-8 through all 7 shops with Next wave (needed --set start_gate=200 to survive without aiming): screen won at tick ~12700, score 220 just before -> 2400 = 220 + 20*109 gate; Enter -> title showing 'Best: 2400'.
Escape at 100: screen paused [Paused, Resume, Title], enemies/bolts/guard unchanged 101..250; Enter (Resume) -> play continuing from same positions; Escape, down, Enter (Title) -> title.
saved false during wave 1, true when the shop opened (tick 1163); next run with the same folder: title texts [name, Best, Start, Continue, Settings, Quit].

Run A bought Quick hands (coins 9->4) and stopped in shop; run B Continue -> shop with wave 1, coins 4, gate 5, quick 1; Next wave -> 'Wave 2 of 8' with enemy at tick 73. Hard save continued showed 'Mason: gate 4 of 7'.

Start from a saved folder -> saved false, next run title has no Continue; lost and won runs end with saved false; Title from pause in wave 2 left saved true and the next run's Continue opened the wave-1 shop state.

Lost with 20 -> best 20 shown on lost screen and next run's title 'Best: 20'; won 2400 -> 'Best: 2400' on won screen and in a later run; a later lost run scoring 0 left 'Best: 2400' (lost screen and next title).
Two copies of one saved folder, seed 7, same script (continue, next wave, shoot): outputs byte-identical. Seeds 1/2/3 put wave 1 walkers in lanes [2,4,8,6,6] / [4,8,4,2,8] / [4,2,10,2,10].

Frame at wave 8 tick 930 (looked at): gate strip at left, blue guard at (2,6), green walkers, small yellow runners, large red brutes and white bolts at the state's positions (40 px/unit); HUD 'Score: 30 Coins: 3 Wave 8 of 8 Gate: 195'.
Frames looked at: title with Continue outlined (menu_index 1), French settings 'Reglages' with Difficulte outlined (index 2), Spanish shop 'Tienda' with Albanil outlined (index 2).
assets/strings/en.json, es.json, fr.json hold all words; UI files use @keys; README 'How to add a language' says to copy en.json to <code>.json and translate.

README has how to play, keeping in settings.json (kept.best, kept.save) in the --settings folder, and the headless and frame commands; both ran as written (the settings path placeholder replaced) and printed state / wrote an 800x480 PNG.

defects: What is kept (best, saved run) reaches the rules only at tick 1, so an input at tick 0 on the title meets a menu without Continue (README says so).
After Title from the pause, the report still carries the abandoned run's score, coins, wave and gate_health while on the title screen.
Spanish end screens read 'Enter: titulo', using the English key name 'Enter' (French uses 'Entree').
On the title the Start button is always drawn blue (primary style), so it can look chosen when focus is on another entry; the focused entry is shown only by an outline.
